text:
maria_g: Noticing a sudden spike in 502/504 from hosted inference in ap-southeast-2a. Latency + packet retransmits around 11:02-11:10 UTC. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/hosted-inference/zone-metrics :eyes:

josh_w: on it — seeing TCP retransmits and out-of-order packets egressing to provider ASN 64512. BGP updates show short withdraws ~11:01:23-11:06:10 UTC.

emily_support: Support is getting multiple customer escalations: timeouts + failed requests. Some customers reporting billing spikes due to automatic retries. Adding sample customer curl they sent:

```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"model":"gpt-4x","input":"hi"}'
```

maria_g: Can we reproduce internally? Any auth failures logged? ops-bot: alert: hosted-api-502-rate increase at 11:03 UTC.

josh_w: Repro locally — tcpdump snippet shows retransmits & OOO (out-of-order):

```
11:02:45.123 IP 10.40.5.12 > 198.51.100.24: seq 1 ack 1 ... [RETRANSMISSION]
11:02:45.127 IP 10.40.5.12 > 198.51.100.24: seq 1 ack 1 ... [OUT-OF-ORDER]
```

josh_w: Traffic alternates between peer-A and peer-B paths, causing reordering. Opening ticket with provider ASN 64512 for root cause.

emily_support: Customer impact: repeated gateway timeouts, intermittent auth token failures (401->retry->502). Capturing request-ids for escalation: rid=rid_11, rid=rid_12, rid=rid_13.

maria_g: Short-term mitigation: prefer bgp-peer-b for ap-southeast-2 egress and increase app-level retries with exponential backoff. Also enable short-lived KV caching for hot prompts to reduce token volume.

josh_w: Applying localpref to prefer bgp-peer-b now (will monitor).

ops-bot: bgp-change: local-pref adjusted for ap-southeast-2 -> bgp-peer-b by josh_w at 11:05:12 UTC.

maria_g: Metrics post-change: 502s dropping, RTT and retransmits falling. Customers reporting improvement but still some residual timeouts.

provider-net-bot: ASN 64512: We observed an eBGP misconfig that caused path oscillation after maintenance. Fix deployed at 11:08 UTC. Monitoring for 60 minutes.

emily_support: Notified affected customers and billing team. Billing flagged a few high-token invoices; will reconcile items tied to retry storms.

josh_w: Follow-ups: add route-dampening for that peer, update routing playbook to prefer stable peer during flap, and add automated short-circuit to KV-cache on elevated retransmit thresholds. I'll open the infra PR.

maria_g: Creating incident ticket for postmortem, assigning eng-network, infra, and support. Action items: attach pcaps, graphs, provider ticket IDs, and impacted customer list. Postmortem due in 48h.

emily_support: Will coordinate customer comms and mark escalations resolved once we have 2h of stability.

maria_g: Marking thread resolved for now. Will update with postmortem link when ready and attach pcap/grafana dashboards. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
